base_cv._structural_explanation: Cherry-anywhere mechanism + low-vol target + high-multiplier tail (200×/30×/20×) jointly STRUCTURALLY incompatible with [3,5] CV band. Reaching CV ≤ 5 requires EITHER (a) cherry1 P ≥ 25% (violates §8 hit-decomposition + brief hit cap 18%) OR (b) drop all high-multiplier pays (violates §7 + §2 brand visibility). v1 lands at 6.12 (already a major deviation from RWB classic CV 10.4 — modern hybrid). Recommend user adjudicates band relaxation to [4, 7] or accepts v7-like CV ~5.8.

feature_cv_conditional._explanation: Per v1.1 §b + X §1.2 / §3.2: widening x_value_weights to lift CV would push m2 P(R≥1000/spin) close to U#5 1e-5 cap. v1 keeps v7 feature_params unchanged → feature CV 0.735 (under [1, 2] band). User §b relaxation also affects feature dimension. Accepted near-miss.
